message: After my sparring practice with Miyako.
Since it had just turned into lunch break, Momiji, Miyako, and I headed to the cafeteria together.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh… so sluggish…」

name: Miyako
message: 「Big sis, you’ve been sitting still ever since then. Is zazen fun？」

name: Momiji
message: 「There’s no way something like that is fun~」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, the stronger you get, the more troubles you’ll have. You’ll come to appreciate the benefits of zazen eventually.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Do I have to do zazen too eventually？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m su~~re Miyako will never do it. If she ever had to, she’d run away from home. I’m positive.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Doesn’t that sound a bit too convincing？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Ahahaha, maybe so.」
It’s a difficult discipline, that’s for sure. I wonder if Momiji will really be able to reach that state of mind……

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, honestly, I can become a Toujinegi even without it, you know~」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, how reliable.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I didn’t, my family wouldn’t be convinced, and I can’t budge on that.」
We picked our food, grabbed our trays, and the three of us sat at a table.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, let’s eat.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Let’s eaaaat!」
Miyako chose curry rice, huh? Yup, yup, that’s charming.

name: Miyako
message: 「Hey, hey, big sis. Why are you aiming to be a Toujinegi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why, you ask…… Dad’s been saying it enough to turn our ears into octopuses, hasn’t he?」

name: Miyako
message: 「I know, but…… I think you’re strong even without becoming one. You’re bothersome, but super strong！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmph, I’m bothersome anyway, so there!」
I nearly burst out laughing at Momiji as she pouted.

name: Momiji
message: 「Miyako, you know what a Toujinegi is, right？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, it’s the strongest person in the academy, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s right, right now Victoria is the Toujinegi.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Victory？」

name: Iori
message: 「Tennouji Victoria is a third-year in the Martial Arts Division.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Oh, really！」
Hearing that she’s strong, Miyako-chan’s eyes light up.

name: Miyako
message: 「Is that Toujinegi person stronger than you, Sensei？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, no, even if they say the Toujinegi is strong, I don't think it's a match for Iori-sensei~」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm, so Sensei is stronger than the Toujinegi. Then why become the Toujinegi？」
I instinctively exchange glances with Momiji. What on earth is this child talking about?

name: Miyako
message: 「You see, I want to become the strongest in the world.」

name: Miyako
message: 「But even the strongest person in the academy is weaker than you, right, Sensei？ Then isn't it pointless to become the Toujinegi？」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I see, Miyako-chan has big dreams. You’re going to be an amazing swordswoman one day.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yep, I will! I’ll become the best in the world and beat you, Sensei. And my sisters too, of course!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Heh, I wonder about that~ Even if you can't win, there are ways not to lose, you know.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Momiji-onesan, you always do sneaky things.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sneaky things？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Like when you fight Grandfather and you're about to lose, you run away in the middle. You make up all sorts of excuses.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji... that’s not very mature of you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「A strategic retreat is also one of the options, you know~ There are all kinds of strength, Miyako.」

name: Miyako
message: 「That’s not strong, that’s just being sneaky!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Aren’t you going to be the best in the world, Onesan？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t think I need to be that strong~」

name: Miyako
message: 「I don’t like that. I’m definitely going to get stronger than Father. And in the end, I’m going to be stronger than Grandfather.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, becoming the strongest in the world is all well and good, but. After that, what do you want to do, Miyako？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Eh？ Hmm... I hadn’t thought that far ahead.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Well, maybe I’ll try <d0065>conquering the world</d> or something.」

name: Momiji
message: 「C-conquering the world, I think that’s pushing it a bit！？」
Momiji’s face twitched.

name: Miyako
message: 「Is it not allowed？」

name: Iori
message: 「If you start trying to conquer the world, Miyako-chan, you’ll become an enemy of the world and end up dragging all sorts of people into it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Your big sister and Tsubaki-chan might end up getting attacked by the entire world.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I see. Well then, I’ll quit the Suzakuin family. If I quit first and then conquer the world, I won’t drag anyone else in, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-what did you just say！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is there no option to just quit the world conquest itself?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm, if there was something more interesting, I might quit that.」
A preposterous theory was being unfolded.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa... no good. I really can’t make this kid the head of the family... Ah, what a shame... I guess it’s me after all.」
Momiji slumped her shoulders in disappointment.

name: Miyako
message: 「Is it not okay if I become the head？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, it’s not okay. If the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association starts aiming for world conquest, the Sengoku period will make a comeback, you know~」
Who will inherit the family headship is one of the common, major worries in warrior families.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, how bothersome~ I wish the family or whatever would just disappear.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Do you want to quit the Suzakuin family too, big sister？ Should we quit together？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, it would be easy if I just quit, but~」

name: Momiji
message: 「But if you and I both quit, Tsubaki would surely end up shouldering all of it, so I can’t do that~」

name: Iori
message: 「So you don't want someone else to have to deal with it instead.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, if there were someone I could push it onto, that would be ideal, though.」
Taking a breath, Momiji took a sip of her drink.

name: Miyako
message: 「Oh, that’s right！ I just had a great idea.」

name: Iori
message: 「A great idea？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Momiji big sister, I think you should marry Teacher. If you do that, Teacher will figure something out for you.」

name: Momiji
message: <s36>「Pfffftーー!!」</s>

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha... w-well, I wonder about that.」
She nearly spat it out, didn't she？ I offered a bitter smile while helping Momiji, who was choking...

name: Momiji
message: 「J-jeez, that’s quite the— *cough*, *cough*！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa, haa… wh-what are you saying?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Eh~？ Is it not okay？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s not about whether it’s okay or not…」

name: Miyako
message: 「If a strong teacher and strong Big Sister Momiji got married and had a kid, I bet that kid would be strong too.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Then I’d want to fight that kid.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you some kind of warrior race? Do you really want to meet strong people that badly?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yep, I want to go meet lots of strong people!」
Hahaha, she really is an interesting kid.

name: Iori
message: 「In that case, let’s go meet one.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh? Meet? Who are you talking about?」

name: Iori
message: 「Victoria, the strongest in the academy right now.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn’t that impossible？ You have no idea how much trouble I went through just to challenge her to a match.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I think it’ll be fine now.」
Until a little while ago, new students were challenging Victoria to matches, which had caused quite a scene.
However, I had heard somewhere that things had finally calmed down recently.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm… then I wonder if she’ll spar with me again.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka got in the way last time, so I really want to have a proper match with her again.」
Yeah, this might be the perfect opportunity. I’d like the Takamura Class to see the current Toujinegi’s true ability, too.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let’s go on an away match. I’ll check to see if she’s willing to accept.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yay~♪ <d0066>Dojo Crashing</d>, Dojo Crashing!」

name: Momiji
message: 「She’s picking up on dangerous terms again…」
I check on Victoria’s status through my device.

name: Iori
message: 「...Oh, she said yes！」
Alright, then let’s all head over to Victoria’s place this afternoon.
